candidates.title: Ring-constrained ideal/Hom preimage recovery
candidates.uncertainty: Can this exact materially distinct recipient mechanism supply public encryption, actual-message recovery, challenge simulation and complete-ring extraction, with explicit quantum/Cat-5 obligations?
candidates.positive_decision: Only an independently reviewed candidate may be reranked for a separate executable implementation/validation contract; novelty, QPT/QROM and Cat-5 claims require their own evidence.

candidates.next_action: Produce one bounded zero-run mechanism packet, then stop for snapshot and frozen review.

ambiguities.question: Does naming a full ring secret make a mechanism EndRing-identifying?

ambiguities.question: Does a chosen field bit length establish NIST Cat-5?
ambiguities.resolution: No; preserve explicit normative reference/attack-resource/reduction-loss evidence obligation.
